people.name: Tenerio
people.role: the Imperial who runs the Alik'r Desert Sanctuary and gives the contracts

unsure.why: The quest's own records don't say how you get to Hammerfell. The Gray Cowl of Nocturnal's quest The Call of Gray Cowl of Nocturnal is the one whose log puts you there ('I am in a desert region, now', 'I'm in Hammerfell'); whether there is another way in isn't in these files.

The conditions on her opening line aren't in these files. She is in the Dark Brotherhood faction and waits at the Dawnstar Sanctuary, so this may need you to be in the Dark Brotherhood and far enough in its quests for that Sanctuary to be open; not confirmed.
The Alik'r Desert Sanctuary isn't in the places index, so where it sits in the desert isn't known from these files.

Her only package sandboxes around a reference inside the Dawnstar Sanctuary cell; she is first placed outdoors in a Skyrim cell the files don't name. Whether you need to be able to get into the Sanctuary to reach her isn't in these files.

Lucya, the initiate in Disappearing in the Dark, shares the Unknown Initiate's package, and that quest's log says Lucya 'was the one sent to find me back in Skyrim'; so the Unknown Initiate is probably Lucya. Not confirmed.

The contract order is read from their logs ('My first ... contract', 'My final ...'); the conditions on each of Tenerio's lines aren't in these files. That Crimson Scar Believers comes after The Crimson Eviscerator is read from the story, not a condition.

quests.name: Ending the Dark Brotherhood in Hammerfell again
quests.plugin: BetalillesHammerfellQuestBundle.esp (no later plugin edits the quest; its people are last edited by The Gray Cowl - Betalilles LoreRim Patch.esp)
quests.canDoWhy: Leollus of the Penitus Oculatus in Ben Erai has found the Hammerfell Sanctuary and asks you to wipe it out.

needs.what: Be able to reach Hammerfell's Alik'r Desert, the region The Gray Cowl of Nocturnal opens

starts.where: Penitus Oculatus Outpost, Ben Erai (Alik'r Desert, Hammerfell)
starts.how: Talk to Leollus; the Penitus Oculatus has found where the Dark Brotherhood hides in the Alik'r Desert and tasks you with defeating them.

quests.firstStep: Defeat the Dark Brotherhood leader in Hammerfell

objectives: Defeat the Dark Brotherhood leader in Hammerfell
Go back to the Penitus Oculatus Outpost in Hammerfell

closes: the Dark Brotherhood in Hammerfell: Tenerio, who gives the Hammerfell contracts, dies, along with two initiates

people.name: Leollus
people.role: Imperial Penitus Oculatus agent who gives the quest; sleeps at the outpost

people.name: Tenerio
people.role: the Dark Brotherhood leader in the Alik'r Desert Sanctuary; a hostile version of him is the target

people.name: Dark Brotherhood Initiate
people.role: two initiates (an Imperial and a Redguard) fight you in the Sanctuary

unsure.why: The quest's own records don't say how you get to Hammerfell. The Gray Cowl of Nocturnal's quest The Call of Gray Cowl of Nocturnal is the one whose log puts you there ('I am in a desert region, now', 'I'm in Hammerfell'); whether there is another way in isn't in these files.
The conditions on Leollus's opening line aren't in these files, so whether you must first have found the Sanctuary, or be outside the Brotherhood, isn't known.
Leollus sleeps at the Penitus Oculatus Outpost; his daytime package has no location, so he likely stays near where he is placed (the outpost).

The gold and the Crimson Eviscerator both come from the quest script's properties (Gold001, DDBCrimsonEviscerator); neither amount nor hand-over is confirmed in these files. The same dagger is what you win in the Brotherhood's own The Crimson Eviscerator.
The quest swaps in a separate hostile Tenerio and fighting initiates; that the friendly Tenerio and his contracts are gone afterwards is read from the aliases, not from the script.
